name: Inue Shinbee
source:
Warrior who holds the orb of 'benevolence'.
He was raised by Princess Fusa and was magically grown older in order to help the Satomi clan when they were in danger.
He's stronger than anyone and fights with his bare hands.
He's [url=/c42264]Fusahachi's[/url] son.
